headline_rule: Report a completeness count (e.g. '14/16 items stated, 1 contradictory, 1 not stated'), never a safety grade.

items.question: What does the first party collect and use?
items.title: First Party Collection/Use

items.question: What is shared with or collected by third parties?
items.title: Third Party Sharing/Collection

items.question: What choices and controls does the user have?
items.title: User Choice/Control

items.question: Can the user access, correct, or delete their data?
items.title: User Access, Edit, and Deletion

items.question: Are international transfers or specific audiences addressed?
items.title: International and Specific Audiences

items.question: Does the product train on user inputs by default?
items.title: Trains by default?

items.question: Opt-in / opt-out / no choice, and the settings path or URL of the control?
items.title: Choice and where it lives

items.question: Which inputs count for training: prompts, uploads, feedback, account/profile data?
items.title: What inputs count

items.question: How long is data retained specifically for training: days / years / indefinite?
items.title: Retention for training

items.question: Do consumer, API, enterprise, or education terms differ (the carve-out trap)?
items.title: Scope: consumer vs API vs enterprise

items.question: Is there human review, and does deletion/opt-out apply retroactively to already-trained data?
items.title: Human review and retroactivity
